sermon.title: The Objective
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Continuing a series on Israel’s journey, this message shows that God delivers us from Egypt—sin—but the objective is to possess the promised land, knowing God. Using a rocket launch as an illustration, the speaker urges preparation with the armor of God, following God’s precise instructions as Israel did at Jericho, relying on Jesus as our fuel, and encouraging one another.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Delivered by a speaker other than Pastor Kincer (likely Michael Silla—confirm). Points to check: “Exodus 6:6 Jesus says I am the Lord”; 1 John 1:9 quoted with “with your mouth”; “Psalms 104” for Psalm 100:4; rocket top speed 36,000–37,000 mph, “Mach forty”; a shuttle that “had blown up” after something hit the wing; Egypt-to-Israel distance. Sensitive content: America “going down fast”; sexual immorality and drugs not ours to redefine.
